title: When the Archive Falls Anew
author: Tamsin Delacroix
blurb: Freya Joubert, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
